task_definition.task_name: Magnitude Estimation using MagNet on Continuous Waveform

task_description.overview: Estimate earthquake magnitude and uncertainty directly from raw single-station continuous waveform data using the MagNet end-to-end deep learning model.
steps: Load the pretrained MagNet model and its checkpoint into the specified device (CPU/GPU).
Read continuous waveform data from a MiniSEED file using ObsPy.
Extract the multi-channel waveform array and apply normalization (zero-mean and standard-deviation scaling).
Convert the normalized waveform array into a PyTorch tensor and add a batch dimension.
Run inference with the MagNet model to obtain magnitude and uncertainty estimates.
Retrieve and format the output as a NumPy array containing [magnitude, uncertainty].

task_definition.agent_prompt: Magnitude estimation using `magnet` deep learning model on the continuous three-component waveform data. Load and normalize the continuous three-component waveform file at {waveform_path} with the specific {normalize_mode} mode. The pretrained MagNet model is located at {checkpoint_path} and its related parameters are {model_params}. Run inference and save the magnitude estimation results into a json file {result_data.file_name} with content {result_data.file_content}. Finally, plot a figure to show the waveform with the detected magnitude estimation results and save it to {waveform_with_magnitude}.
